title: Cấu hình actions/cache@v4 theo mã băm package-lock.json
code:
- uses: actions/cache@v4
  with:
    path: ~/.npm
    key: ${{ runner.os }}-npm-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
    restore-keys: |
      ${{ runner.os }}-npm-

title: Đóng gói thư mục dist/ làm Artifact giữ trong 7 ngày
code:
- uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
  with:
    name: web-dist
    path: dist/
    retention-days: 7
